reason: Follow the exposed disk material toward the neighbouring cloud, addressing the first goal.
expectation: The gas and dust will leave the disk or become available to reach the cloud; the exact outcome is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The outer cloud and tail gas may address the other goal, but I chose to follow the disk material first.

effect: The disk's escaping gas carries fine grains back toward the nursery, while the compact worlds stay behind. I can now follow that flow into the neighbouring cloud.
reaction: The distinction between escaping dust and the worlds left behind is satisfying.
reason: Combine the escaping material with the neighbouring cloud to pursue the first goal.
expectation: The gas and dust will join or interact with the cold cloud, though the details are uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The outer cloud and tail gas address the other goal, but I want to finish following the disk material first.

effect: The disk outflow has joined the neighboring cloud, completing the first goal; I can now follow the material entering the tail.
reaction: It's interesting that some exported grains survive while the two material histories mix.
reason: Combine the outer cloud with gas flowing along the tail to pursue the remaining goal.
expectation: The tail gas may help the outer cloud gather or change as it moves outward; the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The pillars and nursery outflow also relate to the remaining goal, but I chose to follow the outer cloud first.

effect: The outer cloud and cold inflow have formed a reservoir near the tail's base; the pillars remain to be followed.
reaction: The connection back to the first passage is satisfying.
reason: Combine the pillars and outflow to follow the remaining material; it's the only offered combination.
expectation: The outflow may carry or change the surviving pillar material, though I'm unsure how it reaches the tail.

effect: The outflow has carried surviving dense clumps toward the tail, where they can meet the gathered gas.
reaction: The pillars' dense interiors surviving the journey is interesting.
reason: Combine the clumps with the tail gas to pursue the remaining goal; it's the only offered combination.
expectation: The clumps and gas will gather beyond the spiral, though I'm unsure what they will form.

effect: The surviving nursery clumps joined the tail gas and helped form a star cluster, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see material cleared from one nursery contribute to another gathering.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the clumps with the tail gas brought the separate material journeys together in a new star cluster.

leastWorthwhile.text: Gathering the tail gas was a relatively plain intermediate step, though it connected back to the outer cloud.

surprise.text: I didn't expect surviving dense clumps from eroded pillars to help form a cluster beyond the original nursery.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the outflow carrying the pillars was initially uncertain, but the result explained it.

continue.text: I would continue: following material from an old nursery into a new star cluster made me curious where these connected histories lead.
